releases.notice: P13-r2 tester prerelease for 603V1.23.2. Opus recording with support for existing ADPCM files in the app; inherits P12 recording deletion and the 1024 Hz verification clock repair; adds idle BLE negotiation, deadline-based worker sleep, bounded motor cues, lower recording LED brightness and slower idle touch scans, and corrects periodic battery notifications. Application only. Requires the P13-capable Italic app using releases-v3.json. Power savings and touch latency are unmeasured. Software, memory, CPU-model and signature checks passed; physical boot, recording, transfer, discard and recovery remain unqualified. Locally signed with the supplier DFU key; not supplier acceptance. No Ring was flashed by this task.
